item.title: Proud Sky Blues: “These groups are vital — they make sure you’re never alone”
item.description: Established in the summer of 2023, Proud Sky Blues is Coventry City’s official LGBTQ+ supporters’ group — and lifelong fan Lewis Wale is the driving force behind it. Inspired by the rise of LGBTQ+ fan groups across football, Lewis decided to take matters into his own hands and create a space where LGBTQ+ supporters, allies, and anyone seeking community could feel safe, welcome, and fully themselves.
